title: FoColours
description: Server-friendly chat colours with GUI selection and PlaceholderAPI support.
body:
![FoColours cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pTijkOe1/images/e23b3842820248a5e1dc5047d5325e0645ae193a.png)

FoColours gives players a clean way to choose their chat colour while keeping server owners in control of what each player can use. It supports a simple player menu, direct commands, admin-managed unlocks, custom colours, and a PlaceholderAPI mode for servers that already use a chat formatting plugin.

## Features
- Let players pick chat colours from a GUI or directly with `/focolours <colour>`.
- Keep chat setup flexible with automatic chat colouring or `%focolours_colour%` for external chat formats.
- Add built-in, custom hex, legacy-code, and rainbow colour options from the admin tools.
- Grant or remove player colour access without editing files by hand.
- Configure the public menu layout, text, materials, lore, and message colours.
- Import and sync EzColors-style permission setups for easier migration.

![Player colour menu showing selectable chat colours](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pTijkOe1/images/2eb1c4644eef3cf1465565220add5cf7ee1cc830.png)

![Colour manager showing built-in and custom colour options](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pTijkOe1/images/505851a3d767e1c33843ffa9ece76b1fafa2e9f7.png)

![Admin editor menu for FoColours setup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pTijkOe1/images/c3fb2f254c8a8afd950d987e2df4290c0a068f64.png)


## Dependencies
- `PlaceholderAPI` - Optional. Required only if you want to use `%focolours_colour%`.

## Commands
- `/focolours` - Opens the player colour menu.
- `/focolours <colour>` - Selects an unlocked colour directly.
- `/focolours reset` - Resets your chat colour to the configured default.
- `/focoloursadmin editor` - Opens the admin editor.
- `/focoloursadmin give <player> <colour>` - Unlocks a colour for a player.
- `/focoloursadmin take <player> <colour>` - Removes a colour from a player.
- `/focoloursadmin reload` - Reloads config, messages, GUI files, dialogs, and runtime data.
- `/focoloursadmin convertezcolors <enable|disable|status>` - Controls EzColors permission syncing.

## Permissions
- `focolours.use` - Allows players to use the colour menu and colour selection command.
- `focolours.admin` - Allows access to admin tools, reload, editor, give, take, and migration commands.

## Placeholders
Requires PlaceholderAPI.

- `%focolours_colour%` - Returns the player's selected chat colour formatting code.
